purpose: Binary normalization rules frozen before any measurement; remove identifiable build noise before diversity/similarity comparison while preserving raw hashes alongside.

hash_layers.name: raw_full_sha256
hash_layers.definition: SHA-256 of the original linked binary, no modification

hash_layers.name: stripped_full_sha256
hash_layers.definition: SHA-256 after `llvm-strip` (removes symtab, debug; keeps .note sections)

hash_layers.name: text_sha256
hash_layers.definition: SHA-256 of the .text section extracted with llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text (primary uniqueness metric)

rules: Diversity uniqueness counts use text_sha256 and stripped_full_sha256, never raw_full_sha256 alone.
Similarity (opcode n-gram, byte edit distance) computed on extracted .text or disassembly of .text only.
PIE address normalization: function entry deltas computed relative to each function's enclosing section base before cross-binary matching.
radiff2 -s similarity is recorded as a supplementary whole-binary metric and never cited alone as a security result.
No section may be added or removed from binaries post hoc; any change to these rules requires a new frozen normalization.json version.
